school.school_name: 上尾中央看護専門学校

manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify the official-index disclosure site finds the yearless confirmation-form PDF and accepts it only because the current-year prefecture index supplies FY2026 evidence.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the admission support page and inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請.
Classify it as a target PDF whose FY2026 evidence comes from the current-year Saitama official index, not from the URL, anchor, or PDF body.

reusable_rules: Keep anchors labeled 確認申請 as strong target-form candidates even when the link text omits the fiscal year.
For prefecture_aggregator disclosure URLs, treat the current-year official index as trusted year evidence only after the downloaded PDF body classifies as target.
Record year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year so the accepted path remains auditable.
anti_patterns: Do not auto-accept a yearless confirmation-form candidate from web_search, manual, or school_url_crawl sources without its own FY evidence.
Do not discard the PDF as non-target only because the surrounding support page also links many news/common PDFs.
Do not infer FY2026 from the current crawl date.

evidence.notes: Windows v150 Saitama 51-site replay first exposed this as target_fiscal_year_not_detected. Current-code replay after adding prefecture_index_current_year evidence accepts the same target PDF with detected_fiscal_year empty and year_evidence=prefecture_index_current_year.
